players.product: all-flash arrays / DirectFlash modules (hyperscaler design win)

quarterly_data.signal: In August 2026 Everpure secured a second hyperscaler design win (customer not named).

During the second quarter of fiscal 2027, conditions of one of Everpure's long-term supply arrangements were met, triggering a commitment to acquire approximately $1.1 billion of component supply through calendar year 2027; purchases can be made by Everpure or its approved contract manufacturers, Everpure would be obligated to purchase amounts its contract manufacturers do not purchase, and it expects them to purchase substantially all of the committed volume. To support component procurement for hyperscale customers that buy from contract manufacturers, Everpure has in some cases entered into agreements under which component suppliers (not named) commit to sell specified volumes directly to the contract manufacturers, with Everpure obligated to purchase any unfulfilled portion at a price that is fixed or set within a pre-agreed range.
quarterly_data.figure: approximately $1.1 billion component supply commitment through calendar year 2027

quarterly_data.signal: Remaining performance obligations were $4.1 billion at the end of the second quarter of fiscal 2027, of which $44.5 million relates to a lessor arrangement; Everpure expects to recognize approximately 42% over the next 12 months. Capital expenditures were $169.7 million in the first two quarters of fiscal 2027 versus $134.4 million a year earlier; key capital expenditures included equipment supporting Evergreen//One deployments and data center expansion to support testing of new products and services, including for its hyperscale business.
quarterly_data.figure: RPO $4.1 billion (end of Q2 fiscal 2027), approximately 42% over the next 12 months; capex $169.7 million (first two quarters of fiscal 2027) vs $134.4 million
